title: Use stream telemetry for observation, not a hard call fence
trigger: streaming provider Started dropped records terminal usage budget cancellation
guidance: In the reviewed Lab, Started is emitted before HTTP dispatch, but browser delivery is asynchronous and bounded feeds can drop records. A dropped nonterminal delta is not proof that terminal usage is missing. Reconcile the original call's completed/cancelled record and usage by call identity. Cancellation with unknown usage stays unknown; streamed character counts are not billing tokens. Hard admission belongs before HTTP dispatch.

evidence.note: Started precedes adapter enumeration; observer exceptions do not govern execution.

recheck: This is source evidence at the pinned revision, not a claim that the active branch or product still has identical feeds. Inspect current telemetry and spend enforcement before reuse.
